## Checklist

- [ ] The site is live, and the signup or submit page works.
- [ ] The domain is in the Tranco top 1M or the Majestic Million.
- [ ] Public profile pages can be indexed (robots.txt doesn't block them, no `noindex`).
- [ ] It's free, or has a real free tier (not trial-only).
- [ ] People moderate profiles or submissions, and the site has a real audience.
- [ ] It doesn't sell backlinks or DR, and it doesn't require a badge or link back for a free listing.
- [ ] It has no gambling, casino, adult or spam content.
- [ ] It shows activity in the last six months.
- [ ] It's not already on the list (including services run by the same company).
- [ ] The entry follows the format in CONTRIBUTING.md and is in alphabetical order.
- [ ] I've disclosed any affiliation with the site below.
